name: Tenstorrent Warp 100 Bridge documentation
notes: First-party Tenstorrent documentation page for the Warp 100 Bridge. Establishes: part number TX-01002; compatibility with Wormhole n150d/n150s/n300d/n300s with their cooler part numbers; up to two bridges per card; the 2.5-slot cooler constraint on n300d/n300s requiring the triple-slot bridge; and the keyed installation orientation (Tenstorrent logo rotated 270 degrees) with an explicit do-not-reverse warning. CRITICALLY, it publishes NO bandwidth, lane count or data rate for the bridge - which is why tenstorrent-warp100 records null for every rate field rather than reading a figure out of the product name.
